Location Assignment Mode

Auto Default Location
Assign the configured default stock location (type 10) for each location group. Fast and standard — ideal for well-configured warehouses.
Current Stock Location New
Query where inventory actually sits today and use that as the default. Prompts you to resolve conflicts when stock spans multiple locations.
Manual Selection
Choose any location from a dropdown for each part and location group. Full control for non-standard or specialised storage setups.

By default, Apply Changes only assigns defaults to parts that don't have one. Check this to also overwrite existing defaults with the configured stock location.

Current Stock Location mode: The table shows where inventory is physically located right now (from stock tags). Auto parts have stock in exactly one location and are ready to import. Select Required parts have stock in multiple locations — use the dropdown to choose the correct default. No Stock parts have no current stock; switch to Auto or Manual mode to assign a default.
